name: the Eiffel Tower in Paris
features: tall tapering iron lattice tower on four wide arched legs, two viewing platforms, slim spire on top

name: the Taj Mahal
features: white marble mausoleum with one big onion dome, four small domed kiosks, four slender minarets at the corners of a square raised plinth, big arched entrance
colors: white and cream marble with subtle gold finial

name: the Statue of Liberty
features: robed woman raising a torch high in her right hand, spiked crown, tablet in left arm, standing on a tall square stone pedestal
colors: pale green copper statue, golden torch flame, grey-beige stone pedestal

name: Sungnyemun, the Korean traditional city gate in Seoul
features: massive stone wall base with one arched tunnel, two-story wooden pavilion on top with red pillars and a dark tiled hipped roof with upturned curved eaves
colors: grey granite base, red and green painted wood, dark grey roof tiles

name: the Sydney Harbour Bridge
features: large steel through-arch bridge shaped like a coat hanger, road deck passing through the arch, two granite pylon towers at each end, over blue water
colors: grey steel arch, beige granite pylons, blue water
